name: frotzczech
description: frotz(6) end-to-end: the CZECH 0.8 Z-machine conformance suite (fixtures/czech.z5, Amir Karger -- free use/distribution, fixtures/czech-README.txt) runs to completion under the dumb interface.  CZECH is self-driving: 425 tests over every opcode family the core implements -- arithmetic, jumps, objects, the property table, indirect variables, print formatting -- and its own tail is the verdict, so the assertion is the suite's, not ours: 'Performed 425 tests' proves the interpreter survived the whole program (a crash mid-run never prints it), 'Failed: 0' is the conformance claim itself (any Z-machine defect fcc codegen introduces lands here as a count), and 'hooray' is CZECH's own didn't-crash marker.  -m suppresses the MORE pager so the run needs no input.  The story stages onto the image at test time; the shipped disk carries Mini-Cluedo and Book and Volume.z3 instead (see tools/ninja/manifest.json staging).
